versions.changelog:
- Initial release of text-message-ad skill.
- Generates iMessage-style conversation ads as animated HTML and 1080x1920 MP4s with sound.
- Workflow covers brand input collection, script writing, HTML creation, deterministic MP4 rendering, and optional caption generation.
- Ensures usage for marketing/demo purposes only, not for fabricating real conversations or testimonials.
- Includes clear instructions for timing, theming, and verification before delivery.
